reason: The paper is a many-to-many neural machine-translation system, not an LLM serving or inference-systems paper. Its full text does describe language-specific sparse parameter layers and says they scale model capacity without significantly changing inference time, so there is a weak technical adjacency to sparse inference architectures. The contribution is capacity scaling and translation quality across languages, not LLM inference-time compression or a measured efficiency improvement; it is therefore borderline rather than accepted.
title: Beyond English-Centric Multilingual Machine Translation
